entities.name: Militarism
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The belief that a country should maintain strong armed forces and be prepared to use them aggressively to defend or promote national interests. In the late 19th and early 20th century, European powers engaged in massive arms build-ups that contributed directly to WWI.
